entries.title: Revelation of John 14:1
segments: ¶Then I looked, and behold, a Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him one hundred [and] forty-four thousand, having His Father's name written on their foreheads.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:2
segments: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of loud thunder. And I heard the sound of harpists playing their harps.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:3
segments: They sang as it were a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures, and the elders; and no one could learn that song except the hundred [and] forty-four thousand who were redeemed from the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:4
segments: These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These were redeemed from [among] men, [being] firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:5
segments: And in their mouth was found no deceit, for they are without fault before the throne of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:6
segments: ¶Then I saw another angel flying in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to those who dwell on the earth--to every nation, tribe, tongue, and people--

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:7
segments: saying with a loud voice, "Fear God and give glory to Him, for the hour of His judgment has come; and worship Him who made heaven and earth, the sea and springs of water."

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:8
segments: And another angel followed, saying, "Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she has made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication."

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:9
segments: Then a third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives [his] mark on his forehead or on his hand,

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:10
segments: "he himself shall also drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out full strength into the cup of His indignation. He shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:11
segments: "And the smoke of their torment ascends forever and ever; and they have no rest day or night, who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name."

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:12
segments: Here is the patience of the saints; here [are] those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:13
segments: ¶Then I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, "Write: 'Blessed [are] the dead who die in the Lord from now on.'" "Yes," says the Spirit, "that they may rest from their labors, and their works follow them."

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:14
segments: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and on the cloud sat [One] like the Son of Man, having on His head a golden crown, and in His hand a sharp sickle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:15
segments: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to Him who sat on the cloud, "Thrust in Your sickle and reap, for the time has come for You to reap, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:16
segments: So He who sat on the cloud thrust in His sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:17
segments: Then another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:18
segments: And another angel came out from the altar, who had power over fire, and he cried with a loud cry to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, "Thrust in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for her grapes are fully ripe."

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:19
segments: So the angel thrust his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw [it] into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:20
segments: And the winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, up to the horses' bridles, for one thousand six hundred furlongs.
